function read<T extends readonly string[]>(values: readonly [boolean, ...T, number?]) {
  const [flag, first = 'default', ...tail] = values;
  const head: boolean = flag;
  const suffix: string | number | undefined = values[1];
  const sliced: (string | number | undefined)[] = tail;
  const defaulted: string | number = first;
  console.log(head, defaulted, suffix, sliced.length, sliced[0]);
}
read<[]>([true]);
read<[]>([false, 4]);
read<[string]>([true, 'hello']);
read<[string, string]>([false, 'first', 'second', 5]);
function required<T extends string[]>(values: [...T, number]) {
  const [first, ...tail] = values;
  const head: string | number = first;
  const sliced: (string | number)[] = tail;
  console.log(head, sliced.length);
}
required<[]>([3]);
required<[string]>(['text', 3]);
